## Overview

This 2026-09-15 Alipay+ guide is a method-specific add-on to an existing Adyen Advanced API-only integration. It describes the generic Alipay+ payment-method request, wallet selection after redirect, return/details handling and wallet-specific outcome identifiers. Its country/currency lists and examples are a historical documentation snapshot, not proof that every listed wallet is available to a given merchant or that a payment completed. [[adyen]] [[adyen-online-payments]]

## Key takeaways

- **Prerequisites and discovery:** The merchant needs an existing API-only integration that handles a `redirect` action and has Alipay+ added in Customer Area. The merchant-built form lists Alipay+ without extra shopper fields. For `/paymentMethods`, the guide lists allowed `countryCode` and `amount.currency` values; its SG/SGD example response shows generic `alipay_plus`. These lists and the sample `/v72` TEST endpoint do not establish current wallet-by-wallet eligibility or a general API version minimum. (raw lines 23–52, 54–72, 264–275)
- **Request and channel:** Initial `/payments` requests use `paymentMethod.type: alipay_plus`; a wallet must not be preselected through that field. `channel` is documented as required with Web, iOS or Android context, and `browserInfo` is required for Web. The guide says channel and browser user agent affect wallet entry points; iOS/Android in-app contexts use a hosted redirect page that may deep-link or app-switch if supported, with no native SDK integration. A wrong channel can yield an incompatible redirect experience. (raw lines 277–284, 286–322, 461–492)
- **Redirect and wallet resolution:** An example `/payments` response is `RedirectShopper` with a GET `redirect` action, an intermediate shopper action. After authentication and return, a `redirectResult` is used in `/payments/details`; the example response is `Authorised` and resolves to `alipay_plus_gcash`. The guide says the wallet-specific `paymentMethod` also appears in the later AUTHORISATION webhook. The wallet table maps names to variants; a generic Alipay+ request does not make their capabilities identical. Wallet-selection timing conflicts within the page: its early sequence places preferred-wallet selection before the form and payment request, but its redirect narrative places selection on the Alipay+ checkout page after the generic request. Do not infer preselection through `paymentMethod.type` from the early sequence. (raw lines 33–37, 349, 459, 465) (raw lines 324–459)
- **Material source conflicts:** The redirect section says “Adyen then sends” `/payments/details` with `redirectResult`, while implementation notes say the frontend must call that endpoint; the exact caller responsibility is unresolved here and should be checked against the main API-only guide. The details example includes `paymentData` said to come from the original `/payments` response, but the shown redirect response omits it. The `/payments/details` example resolves to GCash, while the following AUTHORISATION webhook sample names Alipay China despite narrative wording about the actual wallet; do not join those samples as one verified transaction. (raw lines 328–347, 351–402, 404–459, 465–467)
- **Limits and environment conflict:** `storePaymentMethod: true` is stated to fail validation; this guide does not support Alipay+ tokenization. It states no Alipay+ TEST environment and recommends live penny tests, with a separate live Customer Area request before accepting live payments. Its `checkout-test` examples and sample successful TEST-looking result cannot prove a usable Alipay+ TEST path, live availability, capture or settlement. The initial prerequisite says add **Alipay+** in Customer Area, whereas the live acceptance instruction says submit a request for **Alipay** in live Customer Area; the naming difference is unresolved, and the separate live prerequisite remains. No financial operation was performed. (raw lines 59–72, 288–347, 380–437, 468–469, 494–504)

quotes.text: Initial [/payments](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/Checkout/latest/post/payments) requests always use **alipay\_plus** (the generic type).
quotes.location: raw line 459, The paymentMethod value for each wallet

quotes.text: Alipay+ uses the redirect flow. Your frontend must call [/payments/details](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/Checkout/latest/post/payments/details) and include the `redirectResult` after the shopper returns.
Tokenization (`storePaymentMethod`: **true**) is not currently supported for Alipay+. Requests with this parameter set to **true** will fail validation.

When `channel` is set to **iOS** or **Android**, Adyen redirects the shopper to a mobile-optimized hosted page that attempts to deep-link or auto-switch into the wallet app, if supported. There is no native SDK integration.
